title: RuntimeSettings
description: config/runtime.yaml: settings of the query loop (blueprint section 13.1, ADR-0030). Budgets are not here: they come from the task, within the agent's limits.

io_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for each read or write the query loop itself makes: the SDR, the event log, and the checks and gates of a proposal. Tool and model calls have their own timeouts.
